source.notes: Complementary Skills / Augment optional rule (#114): Ch 3, 'Augments and Complementary skills' (p.34): 'your character may temporarily add 1/5 of your rating in a complementary skill to your rating in another skill for skill rolls.' Not to be confused with the unrelated 1/5 special-success ratio (Ch 5) or the unrelated 1/5 long-range ratio (Ch 6/7).
